name: Roluperidone
summary: Roluperidone (former developmental code names MIN-101, CYR-101, MT-210) is a 5-HT2A and σ2 receptor antagonist under development by Minerva Neurosciences for the treatment of schizophrenia. One of its metabolites also has some affinity for the H1 receptor.

pharmacology.text: Roluperidone (former developmental code names MIN-101, CYR-101, MT-210) is a 5-HT2A and σ2 receptor antagonist under development by Minerva Neurosciences for the treatment of schizophrenia. One of its metabolites also has some affinity for the H1 receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist; Sigma σ2 receptor antagonist

uses.text: Roluperidone (former developmental code names MIN-101, CYR-101, MT-210) is a 5-HT2A and σ2 receptor antagonist under development by Minerva Neurosciences for the treatment of schizophrenia. As of May 2018, the drug was in phase III clinical trials. The NDA submission in 2022 followed successful completion of a phase III clinical trial which was published in early 2022.

fact.en: Roluperidone was developed for the negative symptoms of schizophrenia, such as withdrawal and lack of motivation, and it does not block dopamine receptors as standard antipsychotics do.
fact.zh: Roluperidone 是為思覺失調症的負性症狀（例如退縮和缺乏動力）而開發的，它不像標準抗精神病藥那樣阻斷多巴胺受體。
fact.zhHans: Roluperidone 是为思觉失调症的负性症状（例如退缩和缺乏动力）而开发的，它不像标准抗精神病药那样阻断多巴胺受体。
